test_overview: Evaluated the threaded-replies feature of a Slack-like chat app (Slack clone, Flask backend + single-page static frontend) at http://localhost:8000 using Playwright with two browser contexts (context_A=Alice, context_B=Bob). Steps 1 through 5 passed with full points. Step 6 (realtime thread sync) FAILED with a fatal verification failure, so per the scoring rules the entire test plan stops and Steps 7 and 8 were not executed. Key details: Step 1: logging in as Alice lands on #general; sending 'Root message for thread testing.' appears in the timeline with a per-message 'Reply in thread' control; clicking it opens a thread view with the root message at top, header 'Thread in #general', a Back button, and a composer. Step 2: two replies appear in chronological order under the root. Step 3: returning to #general shows the root message with a thread summary directly beneath it reading '2 replies · Last reply [time] · View thread', and replies never appear as separate top-level rows. Step 4: clicking 'View thread' reopens the thread with all prior replies; a third reply appends at the bottom; returning to #general the summary (non-fatal) updates to '3 replies' after the app's background refresh. Step 5: Bob logs into a second context, lands on #general, sees the root message with the same thread summary, and opening the thread shows the same root + all of Alice's replies in chronological order. Step 6 FAILURE: with both Alice and Bob viewing the same thread, Bob sent 'Reply from Bob in the thread.' which appeared correctly at the bottom of Bob's own thread view. However, in Alice's context (no manual refresh), within the allowed 5 seconds the reply did NOT appear as a rendered message in Alice's thread view — Alice's thread list still only showed the root plus three earlier replies. (Alice's thread summary line did update to '4 replies · Last reply [time]' via the background summary refresh, so the server-side data was available, but the thread message pane did not gain the new reply row.) Since this real-time verification is not marked non-fatal, the step scores 0 and the evaluation stopped; Steps 7 and 8 score 0 (not run). Two additional non-scored observations: (a) the #general timeline's client-side poll loop can transiently render duplicate copies of a message; (b) the first click on the thread-opening controls intermittently does nothing, with a second click succeeding — existing log notes captured this but it did not change any step outcome. Total awarded points: 10+8+10+8+8+0 = 44 of 80.

steps.description: Step 1 - test_open_thread_view_from_general_message: PASSED. Alice logged in, landed on #general, sent root message; it appeared with a 'Reply in thread' control; thread view opened with root at top, header 'Thread in #general', Back button, and composer. All verifications satisfied.

Step 2 - test_send_replies_and_verify_chronological_order: PASSED. Sent 'First reply from Alice.' then 'Second reply from Alice.' in the thread view; both appeared below the root in chronological order (oldest top, newest bottom).

Step 3 - test_thread_summary_appears_in_general: PASSED. After returning to #general, a thread summary appears grouped beneath the root message with reply count '2 replies' and a 'View thread' control; thread replies do NOT appear as separate top-level rows.

Step 4 - test_view_thread_reopens_with_all_replies: PASSED. 'View thread' reopened the thread with root + both replies; 'Third reply from Alice.' appended at bottom; back in #general the summary updated to '3 replies' after a brief background refresh (non-fatal satisfied).

Step 5 - test_second_user_sees_thread_with_summary: PASSED. Bob logged in, landed on #general, saw the root message with the same thread summary ('3 replies ... View thread'), and opening the thread showed the same root + all of Alice's replies in chronological order.

Step 6 - test_realtime_thread_sync_between_users: FAILED (fatal). Bob sent 'Reply from Bob in the thread.'; it appeared in Bob's thread view but, without refreshing context_A, did NOT appear as a rendered message in Alice's thread view within 5 seconds (Alice's threadList still showed only root + three replies even though the summary count updated). Real-time sync for the thread message pane is broken. Step 0 points; evaluation stopped.
Step 7 - test_create_dm_thread_with_header: NOT RUN. Evaluation was stopped after the fatal failure in Step 6, so this step scored 0 points.
Step 8 - test_dm_thread_summary_and_realtime_sync: NOT RUN. Evaluation was stopped after the fatal failure in Step 6, so this step scored 0 points.
